items.title: Homeopathic consultation
items.text: A consultation with Dr. Rama Mathur, M.D. (Homoeopathy), in Hindi or English, at Raajesh Homeo Home, Banipark, Jaipur. Dr. Rama Mathur keeps detailed clinical notes and records for each patient and communicates clearly with patients.

items.title: Online consultation
items.text: Available by prior booking and online payment. Choose "Online consultation" as the type of visit when you book.

items.title: What a visit involves
items.text: Consultation is by prior appointment, in Hindi or English. Dr. Rama Mathur keeps detailed clinical notes and records for each patient. Please bring earlier reports and a list of the medicines you take now.

items.title: When she refers you
items.text: Dr. Rama Mathur refers patients to other health practitioners when appropriate. If a specialist has advised you on something, please follow that advice and tell the clinic about it.
